description: This PHP script manages the display and processing of execution history for test cases in the TestLink project. It initializes page parameters, retrieves execution sets, related issues, custom fields, and attachments, and renders this information using Smarty templates.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard PHP generic class used for dynamic objects

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input parameters from the request, including test case ID and active test plan flag, and retrieves current user information.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves bug issues associated with executions of the specified test case, using the issue tracker interface.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Fetches custom field values for each execution related to the given test case.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves all attachment info related to executions of the specified test case.
